title: Program Manager
jobDescription:
Vedantu is looking for a highly organized, execution-oriented, and proactive Program Manager to drive end-to-end program execution across multiple cross-functional initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of operations, stakeholder management, project execution, and communication, ensuring seamless coordination between teams while delivering high-impact programs and an exceptional student experience. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity, and can manage multiple moving pieces simultaneously. You will be responsible for driving execution excellence, maintaining dashboards and trackers, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, managing communication with students, and ensuring programs are delivered efficiently and on time. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1] Program & Project Management ● Lead end-to-end execution of multiple programs and strategic projects across functions. ● Create and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics. ● Drive regular reviews, follow-ups, and status updates to ensure timely delivery of initiatives. ● Identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies, and proactively implement corrective actions. ● Ensure high-quality execution while managing multiple projects simultaneously. 2] Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Coordination ● Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Product, Operations, Marketing, Academic, and Support teams. ● Drive accountability and ownership among stakeholders to achieve program objectives. ● Facilitate seamless communication and alignment across teams for successful project execution. ● Act as the single point of coordination for critical initiatives and escalations. 3]Dashboarding & Reporting ● Build and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reports to monitor project and program performance. ● Present progress updates, key insights, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams. ● Leverage data to drive decision-making and improve execution efficiency. 4] Student Communication & Engagement ● Manage student communications across multiple touchpoints, including emails, Whats App, and notifications. ● Ensure timely responses and resolution of student queries and concerns. ● Coordinate engagement initiatives to enhance student experience and program participation. 5] Social Media & Communication Management ● Coordinate and manage social media communication related to programs and initiatives. ● Work closely with marketing teams to ensure timely and consistent communication across channels. ● Support campaign planning and execution for program launches and engagement activities. 6] Process Excellence ● Develop and streamline SOPs, trackers, workflows, and operating processes. ● Continuously identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency and stakeholder collaboration. ● Bring structure and process discipline to fast-moving operations. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
● Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field. ● 2–6 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Operations, Founder’s Office, or similar execution-focused roles. ● Proven experience managing multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously. ● Strong stakeholder management, coordination, and communication skills. ● Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up capabilities. ● Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and dashboards. ● Proficiency in project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Trello, Click Up, or similar platforms.

title: Social Media & Content Strategist
jobDescription: Job Title: Social Media & Content Strategist Experience: 3–7 years Location: Bangalore (On-site) Company: Vedantu About Vedantu Vedantu is a pioneer in live online learning and one of India's leading Ed Tech platforms, empowering millions of students across the country. We're reimagining education through technology, engaging content, and a student-first approach. Role Overview We're looking for a Social Media & Content Strategist to own and grow Vedantu Early Learning's organic presence across Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, Whats App, and You Tube. This is a hands-on role — you'll plan, create, and optimize content that builds an engaged community of parents (30–55) and captures the attention of their kids (4–16), growing reach and engagement without relying on paid amplification. You'll manage multiple channels/pages simultaneously and take ownership of the creator layer — identifying, onboarding, and coaching the on-camera "faces" who front our content. Instagram is the primary battleground; strength there is non-negotiable, and range across other platforms is a strong plus. Key Responsibilities Own the organic content strategy and calendar across Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, Whats App, and You Tube — reels, carousels, posts, stories, and community-first formats. Manage multiple social channels/pages in parallel, each with its own audience, tone, and content cadence. Identify, onboard, and manage the "faces" of our pages — the on-camera talent/hosts who anchor video and reel content — including scripting support, coaching on delivery, and ensuring consistency across shoots. Drive Instagram growth specifically: hooks, trends, formats, posting cadence, and audience-building tactics tailored to a parent audience. Build and nurture community channels (e.g., Whats App groups/broadcast lists) to deepen engagement beyond follower counts. Track and report on performance (follower growth, reach, engagement rate, saves/shares) and translate insights into iteration on content strategy. Stay current on platform algorithm shifts, format trends, and what's working in the parenting/kids content space. Partner closely with content and design teams to keep creative execution sharp and on-brand. Must-Haves 3–7 years total experience, including managing social media for a B2C brand Proven expertise in Instagram growth — specifically, at least one stint growing an account from under 100K followers by a minimum of 50K organically (ideally within the 0–50K range) Experience managing multiple social pages/channels simultaneously Experience sourcing, onboarding, or working with on-camera talent/creators for content Strong grasp of Instagram's algorithm, content formats, and organic growth levers Experience on other platforms (You Tube, Facebook, Linked In, Whats App) is a plus Comfort creating content that speaks to both parents and kids — tone, format, and hooks differ for each

title: Director – B2B School Partnerships
jobDescription: Position: Director – B2B School Partnerships Experience: Minimum 12+ Years Location: Major South and WEST India Hub (Covering TN, MAH, KA, AP, TS ) About the Role We are looking for a heavy-hitting, deeply networked leader to head our B2B Enterprise Partnerships division. In this role, you will lead our Feet-on-Street (FOS) sales engine to integrate Vedantu’s leading-edge educational products into the K-12 school ecosystem. You will be responsible for driving the adoption of our flagship institutional offerings, including Foundation IIT/NEET programs, K-10 CBSE books, Hybrid Learning Collaborations, and Student Integrated Programs (SIP) . If you understand the DNA of school management, know how to navigate the complex academic decision-making matrix, and have a proven track record of scaling FOS teams, we want to talk to you. Key Responsibilities Lead & Scale the on-ground B2B sales team: Direct, mentor, and inspire a high-performing Feet-On-Street (FOS) sales team across multiple states to hit aggressive institutional acquisition targets. Drive Institutional Sales: Own the end-to-end B2B sales cycle—from prospecting to closure—for Vedantu’s school offerings (IIT/NEET Foundation, K-10 CBSE Books, Hybrid Learning, and SIP). School Engagement & Activation: Oversee the strategy and execution of on-ground school engagement activities, workshops, seminars, and student-facing events that drive brand consideration, lead generation, and revenue. Stakeholder Management: Build and leverage deep, long-term relationships with School Promoters, Trustees, Chairmen, and Principals. Strategic Growth: Analyze the school market ecosystem, pedagogy trends, and competitor movements to position Vedantu as the preferred academic partner. What We Are Looking For The Industry Veteran: Minimum 12 years of hardcore sales experience , minimum 4-5 years of B2B school segment sales with a significant portion dedicated to the K-12 school institutional market (Ed Tech, Publishing, or allied school-solution industries). Leadership Pedigree: Proven experience working as a State Head or National Head , successfully managing large, distributed field sales teams. Geographic Moat: A powerful, existing network of school connections in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Telangana is highly preferred. FOS Grit: You haven’t just managed teams from an ivory tower; you have rich experience working directly on the ground as part of an FOS team and know how to coach field champions. Ecosystem Experts: Deep structural understanding of school pedagogy, academic calendars, curriculum purchasing cycles, and institutional decision-making psychology. Why Join Vedantu? This is a leadership role with a high degree of autonomy, offering the opportunity to fundamentally reshape how millions of students experience hybrid learning and competitive exam prep. We offer a highly competitive compensation package, aggressive performance incentives, and the chance to lead a paradigm shift in B2B education.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
jobDescription:
At Vedantu, we're reimagining the future of education by combining technology, data, and artificial intelligence to deliver deeply personalized learning experiences for millions of students. As an AI-first organization, we believe AI is more than a feature—it's fundamental to how students learn, teachers teach, and parents engage with education. From intelligent learning assistants to AI-powered productivity tools, we're building products that make learning more effective, engaging, and accessible. We're looking for a passionate UX/UI Designer who combines strong product design fundamentals with an AI-first mindset. If you've designed impactful digital products, influenced business outcomes, and enjoy using AI to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, and design workflows, we'd love to hear from you. Note: The first discussion will focus on a product or experience you have personally designed and built. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design intuitive, user-centric experiences across web and mobile platforms. Own the end-to-end design process—from discovery and research to high-fidelity execution. Design AI-powered learning experiences and conversational interfaces. Build interactive prototypes using AI tools. Improve engagement, conversion, retention, and overall user satisfaction. Conduct user research and usability testing. Build and maintain scalable design systems. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, AI, and Business teams. Advocate for accessibility, usability, and design excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience in UX/UI or Product Design. Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design. Experience designing consumer-facing web and mobile applications. Expertise in Figma, prototyping, and design systems. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Ed Tech, Fin Tech, Saa S, or consumer technology companies. Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Chat GPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, Framer, or similar platforms. Knowledge of accessibility standards and product experimentation. Tools You'll Use: Figma Fig Jam Chat GPT Claude Cursor Lovable Bolt Framer Miro Why Join Vedantu? Build products that impact millions of learners. Help shape the future of AI-powered education. Own meaningful product experiences end-to-end. Work with talented cross-functional teams in an AI-first environment. Learn, innovate, and grow while solving real-world problems at scale.

title: Senior Associate – Finance (Revenue / Accounts Receivable)
jobDescription: Job Description – Senior Associate , Finance (Revenue/Accounts Receivable) Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Executive – Finance (Revenue/Accounts Receivable) to manage customer invoicing, receivables, reconciliations, MIS reporting, and month-end closing activities. Key Responsibilities Generate customer invoices. Perform customer reconciliations. Monitor receivable ageing and collections. Maintain and reconcile General Ledger (GL) Prepare weekly/monthly MIS reports. Support month-end closing. Reconcile revenue, invoices and collections. Support audits. Improve AR processes. Required Skills Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query). Knowledge in B2B E-commerce platforms. Tally ERP & SQL knowledge. GST, TDS and accounting knowledge. Strong communication and analytical skills. Qualifications BCom/MCom/MBA (Finance)/ CA Inter, CMA Inter, with 2–3 years of Accounts Receivable

title: Student Care Intern
jobDescription:
Location: Remote Type: Internship (Student Care) About the Role As a Student Care Intern, you will be the first point of contact for students reaching out for support. You will play a key role in ensuring timely, accurate, and empathetic support while adhering to defined processes and service-level expectations. Key Responsibilities
1. Handle inbound student queries primarily via calls, and occasionally through chats or emails, in line with defined SOPs.
2. Understand student concerns clearly and provide accurate resolutions within the committed TAT.
3. Demonstrate accountability by owning student issues end-to-end until closure.
4. Escalate issues appropriately and coordinate with internal teams when required.
5. Meet defined quality, productivity, and metrics consistently. Qualifications & Eligibility

EDUCATION:
Graduate in any discipline. Experience: Freshers with strong communication skills are encouraged to apply. Prior exposure to customer support or call handling is an added advantage. Skills Required: Clear verbal communication and active listening skills . Languages : English and Hindi Mandatory. Regional language
- Kannada, Tamil, Telugu is an added advantage. Basic computer proficiency and comfort working in a remote setup.

title: Social Media Intern
jobDescription: Job Title: Social Media Intern Location: Pune (On-site) Employment Type: Internship About the Role We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Social Media Intern to support our digital marketing team. If you're passionate about social media, content creation, and staying on top of trends, this is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience. Key Responsibilities Assist in creating and scheduling content for Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, and You Tube. Write engaging captions and social media copy. Design basic creatives using Canva or similar tools. Monitor social media channels and engage with the online community. Research industry trends, competitors, and viral content ideas. Track campaign performance and prepare basic reports. Collaborate with the marketing team to execute social media campaigns. Requirements Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field. Good understanding of major social media platforms. Basic knowledge of Canva, Cap Cut, Adobe Express, or similar tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Creative mindset with attention to detail. Eagerness to learn and take initiative. Preferred Skills Basic video editing and reel creation. Familiarity with Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, and trending content. Understanding of social media analytics is a plus.
